name: Old Spitalfields Market
text: Old Spitalfields Market is a covered market in Spitalfields, London. There has been a market on the site for over 350 years. In 1991 it gave its name to New Spitalfields Market in Leyton, where fruit and vegetables are now traded.

depictions.name: Spitalfields Market
depictions.text: The Spitalfields Market is a market in the Spitalfields region of Whitechapel borough in London, England.
